title: I will not stay and endure it
odia:
କହିବେ ନାଇଁ
କହିଲେ ଏ ଘରେ ରହିବି ନାଇଁ
ତାଟି କିଳା ମାଡ଼ ସହିବି ନାଇଁ
ଖଣ୍ଡିଆ ପଥୁରି ଧୋଇବି ନାଇଁ।
literal_meaning: Do not say [it]. If [it is] said, I will not stay in this house. I will not endure blows with the door fastened. I will not wash a chipped stone bowl.
meaning_odia: ପ୍ରଥମ ପଙ୍କ୍ତିର କହିବେ ନାଇଁକୁ ଏଠାରେ ଅନ୍ୟଜଣଙ୍କୁ କହିବାକୁ ମନା କରିବା ଭାବେ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇଛି; କହିବି କରି ବଦଳାଯାଇନାହିଁ। କହିଲେ କିଏ କହିବେ, ତାହା ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ନୁହେଁ। ପରେ ଘରେ ନରହିବା, ତାଟି କିଳା ଅବସ୍ଥାରେ ମାଡ଼ ନସହିବା ଓ ଖଣ୍ଡିଆ ପଥୁରି ବା ପଥରର ଛୋଟ ପାତ୍ର ନଧୋଇବାର ମନା ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ଏହା ନିଜେ କଣ ସହିବେ ବା କରିବେ ନାହିଁ, ତାହା ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କରୁଥିବା ଏକ ସ୍ୱର; ବକ୍ତାଙ୍କ ଘରୋଇ ପରିଚୟ ଅଜଣା।
explanation: The repeated refusal moves from speech and staying in the house to enduring blows and washing a damaged bowl. Our editorial reading hears a voice setting limits on what it will accept or do. The changes in person are preserved: the first line is read as an address, while who speaks in the following condition remains unspecified. The source gives no household role or reason for the conflict.
usage_example: Original imagined example: In discussing a passage about a difficult household, a reader notices how each repeated refusal adds another limit, rather than assuming the speaker must be a particular family member.
cultural_context: The repeated ନାଇଁ holds the four lines together. Door fastening, blows and a chipped stone bowl are concrete details, but they do not identify a wife, servant, employer or abuser. The bowl’s newly verified meaning makes the last refusal translatable without constructing such a story.

witnesses.locator: Page9, third item beginning କହିବେ ନାଇଁ, all four lines.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload re-inspected17November2026; original କହିବେ retained. Opening translated as respectful prohibition; conditional subject unspecified. ତାଟି କିଳା ମାଡ଼ contextually rendered blows with door fastened; ପଥୁରି small stone bowl. These readings do not assign household identities. Public shorter first-person version is not substituted.

odia_summary: ଘରେ ରହିବା, ମାଡ଼ ସହିବା ଓ ପାତ୍ର ଧୋଇବା ବିଷୟରେ କ୍ରମିକ ମନା।
english_summary: Repeated refusals set limits on staying, enduring blows and washing a bowl.
